omitted.reason: Server-streaming progress RPC. Exposed via the hand-appended `jobs watch` command (register.go) because cli-manifest/v1 bindings model unary connect-rpc calls only.

AI op submission rides the REST multipart edge (POST /api/v1/ai/{operation}); image/mask bytes can't ride a Connect call, so the per-op submit commands (generate, img2img, …) are hand-appended in cli/domains/ai/register.go.

Analysis execution rides the REST multipart edge (POST /api/v1/analysis/{operation}); image bytes can't ride a Connect call, so the per-op commands (probe, ocr, nsfw) are hand-appended in cli/domains/analyze/register.go.

Smart-select execution rides the REST multipart edge (POST /api/v1/selection/segment); image bytes can't ride a Connect call, so the segment command is hand-appended in cli/domains/selection/register.go.

Host-aware candidate menu for the in-product model picker (a UI affordance). The same facts are available on the CLI in composable pieces: `models list --operation <op>` (catalog), `models select <op>` (the chosen model + gpu_viable), and `backends doctor` (host-tool readiness).
Hardware snapshot for the model-catalog UI's host-aware fit chips (a UI affordance). The CLI already exposes host hardware via the root `vrooli host inventory --json`.
